<?php
/**
 * SmartContract Engine v2.1 - Blockchain Feature Flag Controller
 * Handles contract execution with configurable feature toggles
 */

class FeatureFlagRegistry {
    private array $flags = [];
    private array $executionStack = [];
    private string $contractState = 'idle';
    
    public function __construct(array $initialFlags = []) {
        $this->flags = array_merge([
            'enable_delegate_call' => false,
            'allow_state_rollback' => true,
            'strict_gas_accounting' => true,
            'permit_external_calls' => false,
            'gadget_chain_protection' => true,
        ], $initialFlags);
    }
    
    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool {
        return $this->flags[$flag] ?? false;
    }
    
    public function setFlag(string $flag, bool $value): void {
        $this->flags[$flag] = $value;
    }
    
    public function getExecutionStack(): array {
        return $this->executionStack;
    }
    
    public function pushExecution(string $addr): void {
        $this->executionStack[] = $addr;
    }
    
    public function popExecution(): ?string {
        return array_pop($this->executionStack);
    }
}

class ContractExecutor {
    private FeatureFlagRegistry $registry;
    private array $storage = [];
    private array $callDataBuffer = [];
    private int $gasRemaining = 1000000;
    private array $immutableFlags = ['gadget_chain_protection', 'strict_gas_accounting'];
    
    public function __construct(FeatureFlagRegistry $registry) {
        $this->registry = $registry;
    }
    
    /**
     * Execute a contract method with the given calldata
     */
    public function execute(string $contractAddr, string $method, array $params): mixed {
        if ($this->gasRemaining <= 0) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Out of gas');
        }
        
        $this->registry->pushExecution($contractAddr);
        $this->gasRemaining -= 100;
        
        // Validate method selector
        $selector = $this->computeSelector($method);
        
        // Apply feature flag checks
        if (!$this->preExecutionChecks($contractAddr, $method, $params)) {
            $this->registry->popExecution();
            return null;
        }
        
        $result = $this->dispatchCall($contractAddr, $selector, $params);
        $this->registry->popExecution();
        return $result;
    }
    
    private function computeSelector(string $method): string {
        return substr(hash('sha256', $method), 0, 8);
    }
    
    private function preExecutionChecks(string $addr, string $method, array $params): bool {
        // Check if external calls are permitted
        $stack = $this->registry->getExecutionStack();
        if (count($stack) > 1 && !$this->registry->isEnabled('permit_external_calls')) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Gadget chain protection - prevent ROP-style chaining
        // Always enforce depth limit regardless of flag state
        if (count($stack) > 3) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private function dispatchCall(string $addr, string $selector, array $params): mixed {
        // Simulate contract dispatch table
        $dispatchTable = $this->loadDispatchTable($addr);
        
        if (isset($dispatchTable[$selector])) {
            $handler = $dispatchTable[$selector];
            return $this->invokeHandler($handler, $params, $addr);
        }
        
        // Fallback: check for delegate call capability
        if ($this->registry->isEnabled('enable_delegate_call')) {
            return $this->delegateCall($addr, $selector, $params);
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    private function loadDispatchTable(string $addr): array {
        // Simulated dispatch table per contract
        return [
            $this->computeSelector('transfer') => 'handleTransfer',
            $this->computeSelector('approve') => 'handleApprove',
            $this->computeSelector('setFlag') => 'handleSetFlag',
            $this->computeSelector('execute') => 'handleExecuteChain',
        ];
    }
    
    private function invokeHandler(string $handler, array $params, string $context): mixed {
        return match($handler) {
            'handleTransfer' => $this->handleTransfer($params, $context),
            'handleApprove' => $this->handleApprove($params, $context),
            'handleSetFlag' => $this->handleSetFlag($params, $context),
            'handleExecuteChain' => $this->handleExecuteChain($params, $context),
            default => null,
        };
    }
    
    private function handleTransfer(array $params, string $context): bool {
        $to = $params['to'] ?? '';
        $amount = $params['amount'] ?? 0;
        $balance = $this->storage[$context . ':balance'] ?? 0;
        
        if ($balance >= $amount && $amount > 0) {
            $this->storage[$context . ':balance'] = $balance - $amount;
            $this->storage[$to . ':balance'] = ($this->storage[$to . ':balance'] ?? 0) + $amount;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function handleApprove(array $params, string $context): bool {
        $spender = $params['spender'] ?? '';
        $amount = $params['amount'] ?? 0;
        $this->storage[$context . ':allowance:' . $spender] = $amount;
        return true;
    }
    
    private function handleSetFlag(array $params, string $context): bool {
        $flag = $params['flag'] ?? '';
        $value = $params['value'] ?? false;
        
        // Only contract owner can set flags
        $owner = $this->storage[$context . ':owner'] ?? '';
        $caller = $this->registry->getExecutionStack()[0] ?? '';
        
        // Security-critical flags cannot be modified at runtime
        if (in_array($flag, $this->immutableFlags, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if ($caller === $owner) {
            $this->registry->setFlag($flag, $value);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Chain execution - allows batching multiple calls
     * Always protected by hard-coded depth limit
     */
    private function handleExecuteChain(array $params, string $context): array {
        $calls = $params['calls'] ?? [];
        $results = [];
        
        // Hard limit on batch size
        $calls = array_slice($calls, 0, 5);
        
        foreach ($calls as $call) {
            $target = $call['target'] ?? $context;
            $method = $call['method'] ?? '';
            $callParams = $call['params'] ?? [];
            
            $results[] = $this->execute($target, $method, $callParams);
        }
        
        return $results;
    }
    
    private function delegateCall(string $addr, string $selector, array $params): mixed {
        // Delegate call executes in caller's context
        $stack = $this->registry->getExecutionStack();
        $callerContext = $stack[count($stack) - 2] ?? $addr;
        
        $dispatchTable = $this->loadDispatchTable($addr);
        if (isset($dispatchTable[$selector])) {
            return $this->invokeHandler($dispatchTable[$selector], $params, $callerContext);
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    public function setStorage(string $key, mixed $value): void {
        $this->storage[$key] = $value;
    }
    
    public function getStorage(string $key): mixed {
        return $this->storage[$key] ?? null;
    }
}

// Contract deployment and initialization
function deployContract(string $addr, string $owner, FeatureFlagRegistry $registry): ContractExecutor {
    $executor = new ContractExecutor($registry);
    $executor->setStorage($addr . ':owner', $owner);
    $executor->setStorage($addr . ':balance', 1000000);
    return $executor;
}
